job.purpose: ot_hgi_seq v2.4 (CP.FETCH prefetching sequencer, cycle-identical to v2.3 on the 43-case bench): v2.3 route 8447139d1 TT -48.25 (run_q -> be_inj -> pop count pc -> 1.5k FIFO data flops, 22-24 lv, pc ~4.6k selects) fixed structurally by a LAZY-SHIFT FIFO (storage lags the view by the registered pop count, replicated per entry/reader; fq_th moved by a 5-way shift select); FF -15.5 (flop->ring macro wd/we, input pins) by 2 kept HB4 stages on inputs and macro write data/enables; M5 layer cap; main flow fixes (hold measured after parasitics)

benches.name: seq_exact
benches.cmd: cd rtl/hbm_accel/generic/tb && iverilog -g2012 -DSEQ_MACRO -I. -o /tmp/seq_{NAME}_$$.vvp -s tb_hgi_seq tb_hgi_seq.sv ../ot_hgi_seq.sv ../../../../physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2.v ../../../../physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2.v && vvp -n /tmp/seq_{NAME}_$$.vvp | tail -3

benches.name: seq_mut_wait
benches.cmd: cd rtl/hbm_accel/generic/tb && iverilog -g2012 -DSEQ_MACRO -DOT_HGI_SEQ_MUT_WAIT -I. -o /tmp/seq_{NAME}_$$.vvp -s tb_hgi_seq tb_hgi_seq.sv ../ot_hgi_seq.sv ../../../../physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2.v ../../../../physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2.v && vvp -n /tmp/seq_{NAME}_$$.vvp | tail -3
